thesis: 管理层把 beat-and-raise 归因于 Ignite Operating System 的结构性定价权（Q2 定价 200bps，超全年 100bps 目标）、已完成关税全额抵消、以及连续第九个季度 book-to-bill>1 的仪器更替周期——这些'耐用高质量盈利'的复利属性市场需数周消化，而非仅读 headline beat。
red_flags: 中国收入 -9%（略差于预期）、food -3%、academia/gov -5%；Advanced Therapeutics 与 reshoring 订单权重在下半年/FY27；中东冲突对供应链与物流的潜在扰动。

thesis: 新任 CEO（具 OHTUVAYRE/Verona 商业化背景）把公司重定位为自建销售队伍独立商业化 cytisinicline 并以 $180M 融资兜底，但 6/20 PDUFA 将因第三方厂 OAI 收到 CRL，市场需数周重估'制造端而非疗效端'的延迟与 Adare 转产去风险进度。
red_flags: 明确预告将收到 FDA CRL；时间线信心措辞含糊（'early in my tenure'、'I have not seen anything to suggest we will not meet them'）；pre-approval 沟通受限；无产品收入、launch 依赖 2027 H1。

thesis: 前药物发现壳公司改名'AI compute'转售商，资产与'strategic compute reserve'估值高度依赖高波动加密代币 ATH，新业务 2025 零收入、毛利仅约 8%，促销式叙事在市场消化'无真实盈利+代币依赖'后可能回吐。
red_flags: compute 业务 2025 无收入；$233M 净亏损中 $205M 为数字资产/衍生品减值（反复以'非现金'淡化）；毛利约 8%；市值仅 $8.6M；加密波动免责声明密集；无分析师 Q&A（纯脚本路演）；合同附 subject to deployment/performance；legacy 业务'战略评估'中；CEO 仅 30 天。

thesis: 战略重组（高价值产品组合、45Z 抵免资格、Columbia CO2 利用与 Pekin 封存可选性、去瓶颈+8% 产能）在结构性抬升穿越周期盈利能力，但管理层坦承 H2 乙醇过剩风险，市场需时间权衡耐用的 45Z/CO2 margin 增量 vs. 周期性 crush margin 回落。
red_flags: 对 H2 展望大量对冲（'margins start to give away in the H2'、'as cloudy as it ever has been'）；盈利依赖 45Z 抵免与不确定的 E15 立法；中东/出口物流不确定；Western 分部 Q1 gross loss $1.1M。

thesis: IMPACT 成本项目出现拐点（SWB 同比转降、合同劳务降至 2019 年来最低、节省目标 $40M→$55M）且管理层把 2026 定为业绩低谷、2027 恢复增长，市场需数周穿透'prudent'下修年份的表象去认知自助式 margin 与单一 Epic/AI 效率优势。
red_flags: 2026 调整后 EBITDA 指引中点 $510M 低于 2025 实际 $545M（同比下滑年）；反复'prudent/sober'措辞；HIX 增强补贴到期的 exchange 扰动（假设参保 -20%）；payer denials 与 professional fees 仍高企；2027 起 BBB Medicaid 重新认定。

thesis: 核心手术引擎持续复利（cases +21%、surgeons +23%，surgical 指引与 EBITDA 维持不变），而 EOS 资本设备执行失误迫使下调总收入指引，市场需数周把可修复的 EOS 噪音与耐用的 surgical 采纳故事区分开。
red_flags: 总收入指引下调（EOS 降至约 $77M）；EOS Q1 低于预期、需补强销售与下游营销团队；revenue-per-case 同比 -3%（mix/biologics attachment 拖累）；2027 年 $1B LRP 相对新指引为大幅台阶、consensus 高出约 4-5%。

thesis: 在疲软的照明市场里 Acuity 靠 productivity/redesign 让 ABL 毛利逆势 +70bps 并把组合向高毛利 Intelligent Spaces（Distech/QSC）迁移，市场需数周权衡耐用的 margin/mix 收益 vs. 被数据中心'挤出'、项目释放放缓拖累而下修的 ABL 顶线。
red_flags: ABL 全年销售指引由'up LSD'下调为'flat to down LSD'；照明需求疲软（项目释放变慢、'gumming up'）；关税政策不确定；AIS 增长部分受 QSC 多并表一个月粉饰。

thesis: 新任 CEO 重申 2026 指引（RevPAR 8-9%、EBITDA $502-516M）与多年中双位数 EBITDA 增长，把混乱的 Q1（重组+冬季风暴）定为低点并以 April 入住率、NPS、员工流失等领先指标佐证拐点，市场需数周才敢相信这条后半程加速曲线。
red_flags: Q1 受重组/领导层变动与冬季风暴扰动；指引明显后半程权重（H2 加速才达标）；入住率仍约 82%；两年内第三任 CEO；拐点证据（April 数据）尚早。

thesis: 首次公开季报以监管里程碑（OCC 国家银行牌照）、Fidelity/SoFi/21Shares 合作与订阅收入 +57% 讲机构级数字资产基础设施故事，但 424% 收入主要是低 take-rate 的 gross 数字资产买卖、全年净亏损、平台资产同比下滑被'price-normalized'口径重述，市场需时间辨别真实盈利质量。
red_flags: 全年净亏损 $14.8M（vs 上年净利 $156.5M）、Q4 净亏 $50M；'收入'含大量 gross 数字资产买卖（take rate 约 21bps）；平台资产 -9%、staked -51% 被 normalized 口径淡化；无具体前瞻指引（首个公开季报）。

thesis: Record demand and +15% Q2 revenue growth are real, but a $4B fuel headwind flattens full-year EPS and forces capacity/CapEx/delivery cuts, so the market will take weeks to weigh strong demand against fuel-capped earnings.
red_flags: Q1 adjusted loss $0.40 and Q2 EPS possibly negative; full-year EPS only ~flat to 2025 despite revenue strength; leans on fuel-recapture assumptions (40-50% in Q2 rising to 90s by Q4); aircraft deliveries cut 55 to 49, CapEx and capacity trimmed; 'we'll be sharp with capacity' in H2.

thesis: AECOM raised full-year profit guidance a second time on record backlog/pipeline and AI-embedded contract wins that lift win rates and margins, durable share-and-margin gains the market digests slowly while near-term Middle East drag masks accelerating H2 growth.
red_flags: ~100bps NSR headwind plus delayed cash collection and longer claim resolution in the Middle East; declined to quantify AI-contract upside ranges; H2 guidance depends on a burn-rate inflection.

thesis: Promotional micro-cap pivoting to GPU leasing funded by a crypto-token treasury; a single $260M contract (~$21M/qtr from Q3) is the entire story, and the market will take weeks to discount the thin $35K-revenue base, cash burn and unsigned pipeline hype.
red_flags: Q1 revenue only $35K against trillion-dollar TAM hype; Aethir crypto-token treasury marked down $4.3M yet framed as 'cash' despite non-GAAP; cash fell to $6.9M on $3.7M operating burn; CFO transition; pipeline explicitly 'not signed contracts'; investor-presentation format with no analyst Q&A.

thesis: A raise of NII/PPNR targets on strong deposit-franchise momentum is paired with a fresh single-borrower D.C. multifamily credit blowup, so the market will take weeks to judge whether the credit is truly 'isolated' against the raised targets.
red_flags: $9.2M single-borrower reserve build ($0.23 EPS hit) pushed NPAs to 1.08%; management repeatedly stresses 'isolated' and 'borrower-specific'; declined borrower detail citing ongoing negotiations; D.C. Section 8 / Rapid Rehousing exposure; NIM expected to compress in Q2.

thesis: Clean cost-execution beat (contract labor down 40%, IMPACT savings on track) with guidance deliberately held despite the beat, as management banks conservatism against a known $35M exchange headwind the market will reassess over coming weeks.
red_flags: EBITDA +26% flattered by a $10.9M one-time investment gain (underlying +15%); chose to maintain rather than raise after a strong Q1; exchange disruption/clawback and macro/consumer softness cited; core commercial (ex-exchange) volume slightly weaker.

thesis: ATI raised full-year guidance on an all-time-high $4.1B backlog with structural (not cyclical) pricing locked into long-term contracts, plus a doubling of naval-nuclear revenue and missile demand, durable earnings power the market will take weeks to re-rate.
red_flags: Airframe revenue down 9% with an H2-weighted recovery dependent on OEM build-rate ramps; monitoring Middle East fuel/retirement risk to aero demand though no material impact yet.

thesis: Record year and a Q4 metal-coatings surge (+25.7%) tied to data-center/infrastructure galvanizing demand, but FY27 guidance only reiterated as precoat/residential softness offsets, a mixed setup the market parses over weeks.
red_flags: FY27 guidance merely reiterated after a strong Q4, with EBITDA low end ($360M) below FY26 actual ($367.6M); precoat metals pressured by residential/nonres weakness and >6% mortgage rates; AVAIL JV noise in GAAP results.

thesis: Buckle's women's/denim/kids momentum (5th straight quarter of double-digit women's growth) and accelerated store expansion (12-14 vs 6 openings) signal confidence, but its no-guidance policy leaves the market to infer the trajectory over weeks.
red_flags: No forward guidance (stated policy); inventory up 15.5% YoY vs sales +5.3% (framed as intentional denim build); Q&A lacked analyst scrutiny (retail-investor questions only); declined to provide cash-flow detail.

thesis: Post-IPO, BitGo steers the market away from a 39% sequential revenue drop and a swing to adjusted-EBITDA loss toward 'normalized' share-gain and stablecoin metrics, so it will take weeks for investors to decide whether the reframing masks deceleration or real underlying momentum.
red_flags: Heavy 'look past reported revenue' reframing (gross vs net derivatives optics); adjusted EBITDA swung to -$1.7M from +$12.1M in Q4; GAAP net loss $60.7M on digital-treasury markdown and IPO SBC; extensive reliance on 'normalized'/price-adjusted metrics; no analyst Q&A in the provided transcript (truncated).

thesis: 重申 2026 营收与 EBITDA 指引，但本季营收同比 -6.8%、调整后 EBITDA 高度压在下半年（H2 占全年≥65%），叠加再融资推高年化利息约 $40M——这份被包装成 in-line 的季报实质依赖下半年兑现，市场需数周消化。
red_flags: 无法给出 FCF 具体数字（管理层称 a little bit shaky、需再等 a month or two）；承认 growth rates were not where they need to be；EBITDA ≥65% 押在 H2；再融资后利息 +$40M。

thesis: 管理层语气极强（credit 稳定、funding 极其顺畅、spreads 同比 -125bps、活跃商户 +44%），却把关键前瞻催化剂全部押后到下周 Investor Forum，市场需数周才能把 funding 成本下行与商户加速真正定价。
red_flags: 对上行催化反复吊胃口/回避：won't spoil the surprises、wait six more days、deliberately obscuring；prepared remarks 近乎为空，指引留在股东信而非电话会口头给出。

thesis: 在燃油驱动的季度亏损和暂停全年指引之下，需求信号其实很强——continental yields +20%、corporate +19%、Q2 RASM 有望冲 10%、新签 BofA 忠诚度协议增量 $1B——市场需数周把强需求从燃油噪音中剥离。
red_flags: 暂停全年指引（suspending our full-year guide until conditions stabilize）；Q2 燃油增量 +$600M（约 -$3 EPS）；暂停回购；净亏损；承认 Q2 结果区间 wide and difficult to predict。

thesis: 明确上调指引（现金成本指引下调 $0.10/Mcfe、HG 协同 $50M→$80M+、杠杆 1x 目标提前 6 个月），同时刻意不上调 NGL 实现价指引、把 +$550M 增量 FCF 上行留作 unhedged 未入账——这份被 sandbag 的 NGL/LNG 宏观顺风市场需数周消化。
red_flags: 轻微：对 NGL 价格上行刻意保守不上调（we are very conservative、too many uncertainties），宏观论点依赖中东供应中断（Epic Fury / Strait of Hormuz）持续性；整体披露直接。

thesis: 营收 +56%、EBITDA +82%、去杠杆远超计划（净杠杆 2.3x，24 个月目标 3 个季度即达成），但管理层仅重申全年指引并反复强调保守（HQAF 贡献计零、Medicaid 保守）——市场需数周判断该指引是否被 sandbag。
red_flags: 强劲 beat 却仅重申指引（留余地）；Exchange 会员流失快于预期；HQAF 贡献计零（不确定）；大量 AI / orchestration layer 平台叙事偏营销。

thesis: 核心特许经营增长依旧强劲（NII +11%、EPS +19%、贷款指引 low-to-mid-teens、两笔增厚存款收购），但新增一笔 $33M 不良辛迪加 C&I 贷款、拨备翻倍至 $41M 带来信用噪音，市场需数周权衡增长与信用。
red_flags: 新增 $33M 不良辛迪加 C&I（承认 agents made concessions they should have been tougher on）；$14M C&I 冲销；拨备 $25M→$41M；NIM 4.94%→4.57%（FDIC 增值消退）；管理层披露透明。

thesis: 表面上调全年指引全部来自 College Inn/Kitchen Basics 收购，而有机基础业务被指引为 flat to slightly down，且董事会同时把股息砍 50%——上调外衣下的防御性信号，市场需数周消化。
red_flags: 股息削减 50%（至 $0.095/季）；净亏损 $32.5M；杠杆约 6x；有机业务 flat to slightly down；油/豆油投入通胀抬头需靠提价；指引增长实为收购驱动，掩盖有机疲软。

thesis: 下调全年指引（H2 增长从隐含 8% 砍到 1%、H2 利润率从 20% 降到 15%），竞争加剧、消费者 trade-down 与蛋白/大宗通胀压缩 RTD shake 类目——一次跨季度利润率重置，即便管理层力挺长期 shakeout 论点，市场仍需数周充分定价。
red_flags: EBITDA 利润率 9% 低于指引 400bps；$11M 库存减值；五年来 buy rate 首次下滑；27% 销量促销（同比 +8pts）、18 个月内约 40 个新进入者；蛋白通胀 Q4 加剧；管理层坦诚但负面项多。

thesis: Achieve is pivoting from clinical to commercial ahead of a June PDUFA, but a mid-review manufacturing-site transfer to Adare and a roughly 8-month cash runway are overhangs the market may take weeks to weigh.
red_flags: 'Limited in what we can say about our interactions with the FDA'; NDA-named manufacturer had a GMP inspection with 2 observations; 'continue to evaluate financing options' signals dilution; cash $36.4M vs $54.9M annual opex.

thesis: eXp reiterated full-year guidance while flagging tightening macro and low second-half visibility, and folded in a NextHome acquisition not yet in guidance -- a mixed setup the market may take weeks to parse.
red_flags: 'Growing uncertainty and tightening macroeconomic environment'; 'less visibility into the second half'; NextHome contribution 'modest' and 'not currently included in our full year guidance'; agent NPS stepped down sequentially.

thesis: Alto exits a turnaround year deleveraging with higher 45Z credits and CO2/export optionality, but the 2026 upside is partly mechanical/regulatory and front-loaded with seasonal and plant-outage headwinds.
red_flags: Q1 'seasonally challenging'; January cold weather curtailed Pekin production; multiple planned 2026 plant outages; on 45Z traceability, 'not all of our bushels are traced.'

thesis: ArcBest is positioning for a truckload-capacity-driven pricing inflection and guides Q2 margins above normal seasonality, but the demand-recovery timing stays uncertain off a weather-hit Q1.
red_flags: 'Timing and pace of a broader recovery remains hard to predict'; demand 'below mid-cycle norms'; fuel surcharge/cost timing lag; Q1 operating ratio deteriorated 140bps YoY.

thesis: Amtech's AI advanced-packaging mix is climbing past 40% with expanding margins on an asset-light model, durable momentum partly masked near-term by silicon-carbide/PR Hoffman weakness.
red_flags: 'Limited visibility due to our short lead times'; SFS success 'masked by weak sales of PR Hoffman'; '2026 will be an investment year for SFS'; interim CFO amid CFO and COO transitions.

thesis: Axsome just won a first-in-class Alzheimer's-agitation approval and raised AUVELITY's peak-sales outlook to at least $8B ahead of a June launch -- a second growth engine the market may take weeks to fully underwrite.
red_flags: None material; SYMBRAVO gross-to-net in the 'high 70% range' expected to stay elevated near-term; net loss widened on launch investment.

thesis: BJ's is compounding traffic-led share gains with a good/better/best menu strategy to revive check and mix, positioning for second-half flow-through the market may take weeks to credit.
red_flags: Q2 flagged as 'peak for commodity inflation'; average check only flat to +0.2%; higher workers' comp costs; growth still 'predominantly traffic.'

thesis: Brady's organic growth inflected to 8%+ on data-center Wire ID and new products while raising full-year EPS guidance, with the Honeywell PSS deal set to add ~$0.80 accretion -- a multi-quarter step-up the market may take weeks to fully price.
red_flags: None material; management candidly flagged ~1-2% of organic growth was Q2-to-Q3 fill-in; PSS sales fell ~2% in CY2025 before returning to ~5% growth in Q1 CY2026.

thesis: Record inflows and ~10pt margin expansion look exceptional, but Q1 flows were concentrated in one $16B St. James's Place enhanced mandate and management flagged a fee-rate headwind next quarter from mix shift, which the market may take weeks to discount.
red_flags: Q1 net flows heavily reliant on a single $16B enhanced mandate; CFO conceded fee-rate 'headwind in the next quarter' from continued mix shift to lower-fee enhanced; managed-vol still a slight outflow.

thesis: Commercial base is flat (~$73.6M FY) and the equity story rests on a binary Q2 LOTIS-5 readout while management anchors investors to an aspirational $600M-$1B peak that hinges on approvals and compendia inclusion the market cannot yet underwrite.
red_flags: Every peak-revenue figure tagged 'assuming compendia inclusion and regulatory approval'; strong Q4 revenue attributed to 'variability in customer ordering patterns' rather than durable demand; underlying volume flat; ongoing net losses funded by PIPEs.

thesis: Record backlog ($2.9B) and disciplined selection into a booming gas/data-center power build-out, but FY27 margins are explicitly unguided and will normalize off a Trumbull-boosted 20.5%, a mean-reversion nuance the market digests slowly.
red_flags: CFO declined FY27 gross-margin guidance ('too early to tell'); FY26 margin flattered by Trumbull excess margin (quarterly margins have ranged 11.4%-25%); reliance on lumpy large-project timing ('handful of new projects over 12-20 months').

thesis: Record EPS (+19%) and 54% ROE with heavy capital return, but management is candidly flagging multi-quarter flow headwinds (Comerica adviser departures through Q3, cautious clients, disciplined recruiting pullback) that mute the growth optics, a tension the market prices in slowly.
red_flags: 'Lighter on flows' and 'lumpiness in recruiting and terminations'; Comerica outflows to persist Q2-Q3; asset management still in net outflows (-$5.9B); ~$48B parked in third-party money funds not yet redeployed; RPS earnings only reaffirmed at ~$800M/yr.

thesis: Fully utilized fleet and a building order book against 160-week equipment lead times, yet management held FY guidance despite a Q1 beat out of early-year conservatism, so the embedded beat-and-raise potential may only be recognized over subsequent quarters.
red_flags: Guidance reaffirmed (not raised) despite Q1 exceeding the basis for guidance; SG&A elevated by a $3.7M one-time comp acceleration (said non-recurring); internal inconsistency in stated FY EBITDA top end ($950M vs $915M); CFO retirement transition underway.

thesis: Volume inflected positive (first sales increase since 2022) on data-center/solar demand and management held EBITDA/EPS guidance, but cable-segment margin compression from copper/aluminum and an unresolved strategic review leave the profit trajectory ambiguous, a mixed signal the market resolves over weeks.
red_flags: Adjusted EPS down sharply YoY ($1.23 vs $2.04); cable (~17% of sales) seeing 'significant spread compression'; net-sales guide lowered (divestiture-driven); $136.5M PVC antitrust settlement covers only 2 of 3 classes; strategic-review outcome open-ended.

thesis: Management declares the turnaround complete and issues accelerating FY27 guidance (top end ~15% growth vs 3% in FY26) backed by a growing ~$950M QNX royalty backlog and a secure-comms inflection to first growth in 6 years, a re-rating from 'restructuring' to 'growth' story the market may take weeks to underwrite.
red_flags: FY27 guide hedged, management 'price[d] in some risk to the lower end' on macro uncertainty; QNX Q1 guided sequentially lower ($60-64M vs $78.7M) with repeated 'don't judge quarter-to-quarter' framing; Alloy core has 'no design wins yet'; licensing revenue came in slightly below guidance.

thesis: Sustained women's/kids denim momentum (women's +12%, fifth straight double-digit quarter; kids +16%) plus a doubling of planned new-store openings (6 to 12-14) signals management confidence in a physical-expansion re-acceleration, even without formal guidance, and is slow to digest given men's softness.
red_flags: No guidance per company policy; men's business soft (sales -0.5%, denim -3.5%) and footwear -3%; inventory up 15.5% YoY (ahead of ~5% sales growth, markdown risk); growth leaning on price (AUR +5.5%) with UPTs down ~1.5%; cash flow not disclosed in release.

thesis: A 1M-ton Centurion volume cut (3.5M to 2.5M) and higher met-coal costs are set against a sharp Middle East/Indonesia-driven seaborne thermal upcycle, so the market must weigh a fixable operational stumble against improving thermal fundamentals over the coming weeks.
red_flags: Centurion FY sales cut to 2.5M from 3.5M tons and met cost guide raised to $123-133/ton; met segment posted an EBITDA loss (-$7M) with Centurion ramp cutting ~$80M; multiple fuel-driven cost-guidance increases; Centurion recovery is projected ('largely confined to Q2'), not yet realized; rare-earth/germanium details withheld 'for proprietary reasons.'

thesis: 重申全年 FFO 指引，但悄悄把办公室出租率目标下调至区间低端（Genentech 意外退租），并以'签约未起租'管线为由为 111% 的高派息率辩护——市场需数周消化其近期分红覆盖压力与租金兑现的时间差。
red_flags: 办公室出租率目标下调至区间低端；Genentech 意外退租（不在上季假设内）；One Beach 大单告吹；派息率 111% 却仅称'目前'维持分红（对冲）；Waikiki 酒店走弱；输入文本在 Q&A 中途被截断。

thesis: 连续两个季度 ~$20M 收入或暗示需求企稳，但全部叙事押在 6 月底前的 LOTIS-5 二元读数上——管理层完全盲态、处于缄默期，市场需数周消化这一即将到来催化剂的风险回报。
red_flags: 反复'盲态/无法置评'（LOTIS-5 事件数、OS 成熟度、数据库锁定）；'言之尚早，无法判断趋势'；4/1 起缄默期；明确'今年无收入影响'。

thesis: 给出 FY2027 加速指引（收入 $365-370M、订阅连续第三年≥30%、EBITDA 利润率 21.2%→24% 且路径指向 30%），并以 AI 原生模块与 Marriott PMS 项目铺垫未来 $500M-$1B 增长——市场需数周消化这一超越单季超预期的中期加速与利润率杠杆。
red_flags: 极度自我宣传式措辞（'blockbuster'/到处破纪录）；反复将 Marriott PMS 项目排除在 backlog/销售数据之外；'不保证每季都破纪录'的对冲；输入文本在 CFO 段被截断，Q&A 无法直接观察。

thesis: 订单与 backlog 拐点（订单创纪录 ~$100M、backlog 同比+40% 至 $280M、数据中心占比翻倍至 10%、传统能源/LNG/数据中心多重顺风）叠加 Comtrafo 整合——市场需数周消化电网业务的台阶式跃升，而非仅看单季创纪录收入。
red_flags: FY2025 净利润被 $118.4M 递延税估值备抵释放（一次性）大幅抬高、Q4 亦含 $5.3M 税收益，headline EPS 失真；Comtrafo 购买法摊销拖累毛利；订单能否维持 ~$100M 管理层仅称'希望是台阶式提升'；Q&A 在输入中被截断。

thesis: ZORYVE 在天气拖累的 Q1 相对跑赢（份额升至 48%、处方仅降 6% vs 同业降 15%），叠加密集催化剂（婴儿 AD sNDA 已递交、6/29 儿科银屑病 PDUFA、销售团队扩张下半年见效、ARQ-234 管线）——市场需数周消化其 2027 拐点，而非表观疲软的环比 Q1。
red_flags: 对 Q1 环比收入下滑高度依赖'严重天气事件'叙事；增长兑现大量后置至 2027；毛净比仍在 50s 高折扣区间；输入文本在 CFO 财务段与 Q&A 前被截断，Q&A 无法直接观察。

thesis: 大负荷（数据中心）管线——近期最高 500MW、目标 5/31 签 MOU，叠加 $350M 增量 capex 将费率基数增速抬至 8%——是市场需数周消化的负荷增长期权，但受制于华州首个四年期费率计划的结果。
red_flags: 数据中心 MOU 尚未签署（目标 5/31，后续步骤'尚不清晰'）；大负荷排队从 1.7GW 降至 1.1GW；华州四年期费率案能否和解'无法给出概率'；ERM -$0.10 拖累；结构性滞后 0.6%。

thesis: 工伤保险定价已向上拐点（连续 5 个月提价，加州 2026 已批 +8.7%、建议再 +10%），管理层称要到 2027 才体现在毛利——市场近期或低估这一利润率修复，而纠结于疲软的 WSE 增长与一次性 IRS 税务计提。
red_flags: 宏观驱动的客户裁员持续（虽在放缓）；staffing 收入 -21%；加州两大市场放缓；一次性 $11.6M IRS 税务计提（$0.46/股，上诉中）；毛利修复后置至 2027。

thesis: 女装（+11%）与童装（+16%）动能叠加客单价/牛仔裤价位上行、商品毛利维持纪录水平（仅降 10bps），显示定价权与品类结构改善——尽管公司政策上不给指引且 4 月消费转弱，市场或需数周消化这一韧性。
red_flags: 公司政策不提供任何销售/盈利指引；4 月'略微转弱'；库存同比+13.5%（快于销售+6.1%）；关税压商品毛利；燃油附加费未对冲；Q1 营业利润率受一次性 $19.1M 交换费诉讼和解（660bps）大幅美化；激励薪酬前置。

thesis: 表观 2% 有机增长掩盖下半年拐点：三大特异性逆风（QBE 已 5/1 翻篇、Medicare 扰动、IAS 收入确认）将于 Q2 末消退，同时 CAC 协同已 actioned ~80% 且领先计划——市场或需数周看穿疲软表观、消化管理层指引的加速。
red_flags: 表观有机增长仅 2%（层层'调整'至 5%、pro forma 9%）；GAAP 净亏损 $1.9M；调整后 EBITDA 利润率降 170bps；自由现金流近乎持平（$60M 营运资金占用）；净杠杆偏高 4.3x；增长依赖逆风翻篇与下半年'拐点'。

thesis: Management raised its combined performance-fee outlook and touts a record $27.5B institutional pipeline plus a transformative Equitable-Corebridge merger, positives the market may take weeks to weigh against persistent active-equity outflows and margin compression.
red_flags: Firm-wide active net outflows ~$6B (active equity ~$11B); adjusted margin down 30bps; fee rate declining on negative mix; hedging such as notwithstanding near-term headwinds and mixed dynamics; private-market perf fees light on software/tech markdowns.

thesis: Adeia landed foundational AMD and Microsoft licenses that validate its hybrid-bonding semiconductor IP as a durable new revenue engine the market may take weeks to appreciate, even as a CEO health-related departure and Dish litigation cloud the near term.
red_flags: CEO stepping down for health reasons with no successor named; Dish renewal failed and heading to litigation plus DirecTV dispute; recurring revenue fell to $66.3M from $94.5M on subscriber declines and renewal timing; management declined to break out AMD retroactive/one-time revenue.

thesis: AdaptHealth executed the largest patient transition in HME history and raised full-year revenue guidance, with an accelerating capitated-contract pipeline and regulatory tailwinds favoring scaled operators setting up a margin ramp (Q2 EBITDA guided to ~$160M) the market may take weeks to trust after the Q1 EBITDA miss.
red_flags: Q1 adjusted EBITDA missed guidance by ~$7M on elevated transition labor (~$12M); full-year EBITDA/FCF only maintained not raised; Q1 free cash flow negative; net leverage up to 3.0x from 2.75x. Management frames labor costs as transitory.

thesis: Amerant's interim-CEO-led turnaround shows early traction via ~$30M cost savings and fast-growing low-cost Venezuelan deposits, but continued classified-loan exits and NIM compression mean the market needs weeks to judge whether the credit cleanup is truly de-risking the franchise.
red_flags: Interim CEO; ongoing classified/NPL loan exits and downgrades (NPLs $176.1M, 1.78% of assets); provision up to $7.8M from $3.5M; NIM compression to 3.55% from 3.78% and guided lower; heavy reliance on concentrated Venezuela deposit growth.

thesis: Arvinas won the first-ever FDA approval of a PROTAC degrader and monetized it via a Rigel license, validating its platform and funding a deep phase I pipeline into 2H2028, but the market needs weeks to reweight the story after the lead neuro program ARV-102 landed on US clinical hold.
red_flags: Lead program ARV-102 phase Ib on US clinical hold pending chronic tox data (US start pushed to end-2026); Q1 revenue collapsed to $15.6M from $188.8M YoY on Pfizer collaboration remeasurement; company out-licensed its only approved asset; multiple pipeline readouts still pending.

thesis: Aveanna's preferred-payer strategy drove a 75% EBITDA surge in 2025, but flat 2026 EBITDA guidance ($318-322M) framed as prudent signals management caution the market will spend weeks reconciling against strong operational momentum and the accretive Family First deal.
red_flags: 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance flat versus 2025 (which had a 53rd-week benefit); repeated challenging-environment and prudent-view hedging; leverage ~4x with ~$1.49B variable-rate debt (largely hedged).

thesis: Build-A-Bear delivered record 2025 revenue but guided 2026 pretax income to flat-or-down on $16M of tariffs and e-commerce softness amid a CEO succession, a peak-earnings concern the market may take weeks to price against the brand's international-expansion and IP momentum.
red_flags: 2026 pretax income guided to mid-single-digit decline to low-single-digit growth on tariffs/investment; Q4 pretax income and EPS fell YoY; e-commerce demand down 13.6% in Q4 on Google AI/SEO headwinds and delayed digital upgrades; CEO retiring; Q1 traffic challenging.

thesis: BioLife's razor-and-blade biopreservation-media franchise (>70% trial share, 17 approved therapies with 9 more within 12 months) sets up durable recurring-revenue growth and a first full-year GAAP profit, a compounding story the market may take weeks to re-rate despite only-affirmed guidance and a transitory bag-yield margin drag.
red_flags: Gross margin declined YoY (64% vs 68%) on a transitory bag-yield issue not fixed until Q4 2026/Q1 2027; guidance only affirmed not raised; mix shift to lower-margin bags; cross-sell adoption cycles longer.

thesis: 首次实现单季度正毛利并将电池回收产能扩至第二座工厂、同时锂项目获联邦快速许可——从烧钱转向单位经济可行的拐点，市场需数周消化。
red_flags: 本场无分析师 Q&A；'正毛利'依赖剔除折旧与股权激励的现金口径，九个月累计仍未达调整后毛利转正；股权激励费用确认不规则。

thesis: 受监管公用事业重申 2026 EPS 指引，但强调已签的 2.2GW 数据中心 ESA 属计划外上行，随项目里程碑在未来数季转化，构成慢速上修铺垫。
red_flags: 增长依赖数据中心 ESA 的爬坡时点（'we'll see whether those come to fruition'）；反复用 optimistic/hopeful 对转化时点对冲。

thesis: 工业分销需求拐头——有机增速从 2% 加速到 6%，3 月 +10%、4 月高个位数，订单/backlog 创纪录并上调指引；在关税/宏观谨慎氛围下市场或低估这一广谱工业复苏。
red_flags: 四季度有机指引（4%-5.5%）隐含在更难同比的 5/6 月减速；管理层称关税/通胀环境 'highly fluid'。

thesis: 信仰向流媒体以 David 等影片把 Guild 会员推至 2.2M、营收同比 +254%，并首次给出 2026 调整后 EBITDA 亏损收窄至≤$25M 的指引；若会员飞轮兑现，市场需数周重估亏损收窄路径。
red_flags: Q4 净亏损翻倍至 $79M、销售营销开支 $121M 超过营收；管理层大量 AI/愿景式宣讲；被问 David 具体营销开支时以'未披露该具体数字'回避。

thesis: 新上市精密零部件复合增长平台指引 2026 营收 +18%/EBITDA +27%，且全年 90% 已在 backlog、EBITDA 利润率 38%+，罕见的高前瞻可见度与信心，IPO 后市场或需数周重估。
red_flags: 可见度高度依赖自有 Arxis EDGE backlog 系统的说法；近端 SBC（约 $155M）与摊销偏高；增长依赖 Arcline 主导的持续并购。

thesis: 居家护理在偏好付方策略下三大板块全部双位数增长、Q1 超预期并上调全年营收/EBITDA 指引；管理层直面 Home Health 新登记暂缓令称'零影响'，市场需数周消化监管担忧的证伪。
red_flags: 增长依赖偏好付方协议与州费率上调的持续兑现；杠杆仍高（约 $14.8 亿浮动利率债，大部分已对冲）；Q1 自由现金流为负（季节性低点）。

thesis: 创纪录年度后，2026 指引因 $16M 关税拖累致利润持平至下滑并宣布 CEO 交接；市场需数周在品牌/全球扩张故事与近端毛利及电商疲软间权衡。
red_flags: 2026 税前利润指引含中个位数下滑可能；Q4 电商需求 -13.6%（部分归因 Google AI/SEO 变化）；一季度客流疲软；依赖不确定的关税假设/潜在退款。

thesis: 云存储 Q1 双超预期、B2 增速 24% 并上调全年营收与 EBITDA 利润率指引，AI（Neocloud/多模态）驱动 1/3+ 新签、AI 客户同比 +76%；市场或需数周重估其低成本硬盘存储在 AI 时代的杠杆。
red_flags: 整体营收增速仅 12%（B2 以外拖累）；指引口径刻意剔除 >$50 万大单与超额变量用量；Q1 自由现金流为负、Q2 EBITDA 利润率环比下台阶。

thesis: Identified ZivaSkin demand jumped to 100+ eligible patients with no payer denials or attrition, but actual treatment throughput is slow and highly variable, so the launch ramp won't prove out for several quarters.
red_flags: Speed of patient treatment 'significantly varied'; first patients took a 'long time' through the funnel; timelines 'very variable' ~4-5 months; profitability question not directly answered; only 2 patients treated to date.

thesis: Q4 beat plus initial FY26 operating-profit guide of $390-410M (up ~20% vs $328M) on Aerie/OFFLINE acceleration signals durable momentum the market may under-weight given noisy H1 tariff optics.
red_flags: Q1 operating income guided weak at $20-25M with ~80% of profit in H2; gross margin down 30bps; $130M+ annual tariff headwind; outlook excludes recent Supreme Court/tariff developments.

thesis: Record Q1 (TRASM +16.4%, EPS $3.77) is overshadowed by a fuel-driven Q2 loss guide (~1% op margin, -$0.50 EPS) and capacity cuts, while resilient underlying leisure demand and the Sun Country close are the slow variables.
red_flags: Withheld full-year guidance; Q2 guided to a loss on $4.35/gal fuel (+$120M expense vs prior expectations); ASMs cut ~6.5% Q2 and Q3 flat-to-down; near-term earnings step down sharply.

thesis: Revenue +143% and first-ever positive adjusted EBITDA validate the Guild subscription flywheel, but 7 of 10 theatrical releases and their revenue land in H2, so cash-conversion durability won't be visible for weeks; FY still guided to an EBITDA loss.
red_flags: Heavy promotional/vision framing ('flywheel','moat','renaissance','35x TAM'); still guiding full-year EBITDA loss (<=$25M); results acknowledged 'lumpy' with cost/revenue timing mismatch; recent $34.5M dilutive raise to clear a debt-covenant overhang.

thesis: Q4 comp fell -1.6% but a 140bps margin gain and a cautious flat-to-modest FY26 comp guide understate multiple self-help levers (loyalty/credit-card relaunch, new stores, better/best brands, World Cup and 250th tailwinds) plus a disclosed QTD-positive comp.
red_flags: Q4 comp negative with transactions -6.4% (growth all from +5.1% ticket/price); guidance low end assumes negative comp; repeated macro caution on lower/middle-income consumer; leans on external tailwinds (tax refunds, World Cup).

thesis: A messy quarter (revenue miss, FY26 guide cut to $1.85-1.95B, $151M goodwill impairment, SCAR contract terminated) is framed as shutdown/timing-driven, while a record $4.6B YTD order book and a promised 'record Q4' set up FY27.
red_flags: SCAR contract terminated for convenience after failed renegotiation; $151M goodwill impairment on the space business; Q3 missed and full-year guidance lowered; heavy 'commercialization pivot' spin to explain program losses; orders 'shifted to the right.'

thesis: A demand miss (domestic traffic -7%, e-commerce demand -26%) and a revenue-guidance cut are partly masked by a one-time tariff refund lifting pre-tax income; the recovery is a back-half bet (Halloween, 30th anniversary, Harry Potter, Walmart wholesale) amid a CEO transition.
red_flags: Revenue guidance cut; Q1 missed own flat guide; PTI 'raise' is entirely a $7M tariff one-off offsetting lower operating performance; Q2 guided weaker than Q1; e-commerce demand -26% on AI-search disruption; CEO handover mid-year.

thesis: A 9% revenue miss reset FY26 to flat-vs-2025 (from a growth setup), framed as a 'timing air pocket'; the slow variable is whether the large awarded AMI backlog (2.6-3.6M connections) actually deploys in H2 as promised, alongside a new UDlive sewer-monitoring deal.
red_flags: Revenue missed by $15-20M on short-cycle weakness; FY guide reset from growth to 'in line with 2025'; 10% executive salary cut for 6 months (defensive); unusual disclosure of anonymized project detail 'not normally provided' to reassure; Q2 guided down YoY.

thesis: ZEVASKYN launch is showing accelerating leading indicators (5 patients treated, 6 QTCs, 95% covered lives, 100+ identified patients) that could take the market weeks to accept as durable rare-disease demand rather than early-launch noise.
red_flags: Management repeatedly hedged on Q2 patient-conversion timing ('very hard to predict... is it 1, is it 2, is it 3'); no formal financial guidance, only qualitative leading indicators; simultaneously deprioritized ophthalmology and pivoted capital into a preclinical PSMA CAR-T asset.

thesis: A strong Q4 beat and Aerie/OFFLINE +23% momentum sit alongside a confident FY2026 growth guide, but the market may take weeks to digest that tariffs and ad spend front-load pressure into H1 with ~80% of profit weighted to H2.
red_flags: Heavy tariff headwind (~$130M/yr, ~$30M/quarter) pressuring the first half; Q1 operating income guided sharply lower to $20-25M; AE Women's comp flat with deeper denim markdowns; CEO absent from Q&A.

thesis: A newly-public, non-cyclical compounder with record 25.5% EBITDA margins, but the market may take weeks to register that initial 2026 guidance normalizes growth to 5-7% (down from +13% in 2025).
red_flags: 2026 revenue-growth guide (5-7%) decelerates sharply from 2025 (+13%) and explicitly 'takes into consideration normalization of benefits from customers who have returned'; heavily promotional first-public-call narrative; one-time IPO-related charges ($16M option vesting, elevated tax rate).

thesis: APi raised full-year revenue and EBITDA guidance on 10% organic growth and 25% Specialty Services growth (described as broad-based, not just data centers), a durable inspection/service/monitoring mix shift the market may take weeks to fully re-rate.
red_flags: Adjusted gross margin declined 40bps on business mix; the guidance raise is partly offset by a strengthening-USD/FX headwind and excludes the not-yet-closed Wtech/Onyx deals; growth increasingly reliant on >$1B of M&A and its integration.

thesis: Academy delivered +140bps gross-margin expansion despite a negative Q4 comp, but cautious FY2026 guidance straddling zero comp and heavy reliance on external tailwinds (World Cup, tax refunds, 250th anniversary) may keep the market weighing consumer softness for weeks.
red_flags: Q4 comp negative (-1.6%) with transactions down 6.4%; full-year comp guide straddles zero (-1% to +2%); repeated caution on 'muted' discretionary spending and macro pressure on low/middle-income consumers; upside leans on uncertain external events.

thesis: A war-driven ~$9M revenue pushout and ~600bps gross-margin compression mask improving FY2027 growth drivers (MDU fixed-wireless, utility grid capex, BEAD), a timing disconnect the market may take weeks to separate from the weak print.
red_flags: ~$9M revenue pushed out by Middle East conflict with management flagging risk of repeats ('careful about potential repeats'); gross margin fell to 29.4% from 35.8% YoY; the growth story is pushed to FY2027/FY2028 rather than near-term; wide Q4 guidance range acknowledging ongoing geopolitical risk.

thesis: Brink's reaffirmed its unchanged 2026 framework on a 13th straight quarter of 15%+ AMS/DRS growth (approaching a third of revenue), a recurring-revenue mix shift the market may take weeks to weigh against modest 4.5% total organic growth and NCR Atleos integration risk.
red_flags: Reported 10% growth heavily aided by a +6% FX tailwind (organic only 4.5%, CVM organic just 1%); TTM FCF conversion (50%) guided back down to 40-45%; large pending NCR Atleos acquisition lifts leverage to ~3.4x at close, adding integration and balance-sheet risk.

thesis: BioMarin raised total revenue guidance to ~20% growth via the just-closed Amicus deal (Galafold/Pombiliti-Opfolda), but the market may take weeks to separate the inorganic step-up and a soft, H2-weighted Q1 from underlying organic momentum (Voxzogo +20% patient adds, Palynziq adolescent launch, two Q2 pivotal readouts).
red_flags: The guidance raise is entirely acquisition-driven while underlying BioMarin EPS guidance 'remains unchanged'; Q1 carried a $31M Naglazyme manufacturing charge and Palynziq destocking; Amicus is slightly dilutive to 2026 EPS; revenue heavily back-half weighted (>55% of revenue and ~2/3 of EPS in H2); Voxzogo now faces a new U.S. competitor.

thesis: 管理层把一个 Phase 1 资产包装成 $25B AGA 加 endometriosis 的双重 multi-billion 机会，市场需数周才会看清该 TAM 仅基于 hypothetical survey 而非临床结果。
red_flags: TAM 与需求全部基于 hypothetical product profile 与 consumer survey；反复出现 'if successfully developed and approved' 等条件句；Q&A 在文本中于开场即被截断，未见任何问答。

thesis: Aerie 突破 $2B 且 +34% 的强势掩盖了同名 AE 品牌 women's bottoms 的持续疲软，市场需几周判断 back-to-school 能否让 AE 拐点向上。
red_flags: AE denim 具体打法以 'That is all I can say' 回避；承认 'May started slowly'；大量促销式措辞（'candy shop'、'firing on all cylinders'）淡化 AE 品牌软弱。

thesis: 一家 replacement-driven、抗周期的必需品龙头低调上调全年 revenue 与 EBITDA guidance，同时搭建 connected-machine 加 Scan-Pay-Wash 支付平台，市场尚未为该数字化 optionality 定价。
red_flags: Scan-Pay-Wash 变现被刻意推迟（'more focused today on adoption'，仅 clip 极小费用）；能效 selling point 承认需数季度才会显现。

thesis: CoreWeave SPV 评级从 BB 跃升至 A3 结构性地为租约簿 de-risk 并将压低再融资成本，这一信用改善市场消化慢，却被当季 GAAP 巨亏掩盖。
red_flags: GAAP 净亏 $100.9M 与 $59.7M 减值被 adjusted EBITDA 框架淡化；SBC 高达 $39.3M；对再融资 rate 节约幅度拒给具体数字；自认 'cost of capital is higher than it should be'；South Dakota site 被延迟。

thesis: 一个 pre-commercial 'critical materials' 平台前置了 2031 年 >$300M EBITDA 叙事与 helium 短缺 windfall，而实际 product revenue 仅 $5.7M 且各产线投产时点持续滑动。
red_flags: 明确拒给 2026 精确 guidance（'challenging to give exact guidance'）；投产反复表述为 'around mid-year or Q3'；各产线收入估算自称 'my guess'；出现口误 '2023'；靠 helium listing 与 QLE spin-out 来释放价值。

thesis: base label-materials 的份额增长与成熟的 pricing playbook 正抵消 high-value 与 Intelligent Labels 的疲软及原材料通胀 spike，H2 的 Walmart food RFID 放量是慢变量催化剂。
red_flags: 3 月 prebuy 拉动（约 $0.05 的 Q1 顺风）将在 Q2 下半段 destock 回吐；Intelligent Labels 低于预期、logistics 同比 -low double digits；high-value 下滑被称为 'temporary softness'。

thesis: 创纪录的 +44% broker 业绩被市场当作一次性地缘波动而折价，但 FMX 的 UST 结构性份额（41%）与 OTC 能源经纪特许权是持久的，市场需数周 re-rate。
red_flags: Q2 guidance 增速骤降至 +4%（对比 Q1 的 +44%），以 Iran conflict 与 Liberation Day comp 重新解释；管理层自认这是 'one of the more challenging times to give guidance'；FMX futures 未平仓量环比下降。

thesis: 稳健的 net-lease 复利叠加 $382M build-to-suit 内嵌增长，以及市场尚未定价的 1 GW Project Triboro 数据中心 optionality。
red_flags: Project Triboro 仍取决于 zoning（council 未通过修订、进入 180 天流程）、power（PPL 2027 年夏才开工）与 tenant identification，全部推迟到 2026 年底才决策；Q1 零 bad debt 仍保守保留 75bps 坏账假设。

thesis: 管理层把全部资源押注 prolactin 平台（新增 ABS-202、deprioritize 肿瘤 ABS-301/501），用 hypothetical TPP 调研撑起 $25B TAM 叙事，但 ABS-201 尚无任何疗效数据——市场需数周消化这次 pipeline 重定向的真实含金量。
red_flags: 对无疗效数据的 Phase I/IIa 资产做 'home run'/$25B TAM 强促销；TAM 基于 'hypothetical product profile' 调研（明确非临床结果）；砍掉两个肿瘤项目；现金一季度降 $18.6M；'agentic AI'/'Unlimiters' 空话偏多。

thesis: LiDAR 商用化确有实质进展（Daimler 量产意向 C-sample 交付、NVIDIA DRIVE Hyperion 参考传感器、Nikon 量产），并新讲数据中心 CPO/硅光故事；市场需数周权衡真实汽车 traction 与持续烧钱、且完全未给营收指引之间的落差。
red_flags: 动能叙事强但未给任何前瞻营收指引；数据中心 CPO 机会高度早期、被推到 '明年再谈'；单季 gross cash use $28.1M 持续烧钱；流动性依赖 $125M 未提取授信。

thesis: 新任 CEO 的 turnaround 已带来真实的 Q1 超预期与销售/续约改善，但 headline 营收仍下滑、指引暗示未来数季度继续承压——市场需数周把底层改善与仍难看的表观数据（及 turnaround 中途 CFO 离任）区分开。
red_flags: CFO Greg Giometti 离任（再度 CFO 变动，CAO 接任 interim）；'未来数季度' 营收持续承压；销售动能仅定性描述（'越来越好'）缺硬数据；Q2 指引隐含营收同比及环比继续下滑。

thesis: 酒店 REIT 基于确实强劲的 Q1（3 月 RevPAR +5.8%、4 月 +4%）上调全年 RevPAR 指引，并反复暗示上调后仍偏保守（FIFA 世界杯 + 去年政府扰动低基数）；市场需数周消化管理层信号的上行 optionality，而非仅看 1% 的温和 headline。
red_flags: headline 温和（RevPAR 中值仅 1%）与偏乐观口吻并存；承认地缘/宏观不确定（中东、能源）；今年到期债务仍在与无担保 lender 协商；指引仍以 'measured/conservative' 对冲。

thesis: Astrana 交出 43% 增长的记录季并给出强劲 2026 增长指引、论证自身在 2027 MA 费率变动中 '结构性占优'，却同时披露内控 material weakness 与延迟 10-K——市场需数周权衡治理红旗与强劲经营动能。
red_flags: 财报内控 material weakness（并购/purchase accounting），Form 12b-25 延迟 10-K；'structurally advantaged' 叙事偏重；指引低端被定性为 'stacked downside case'；Prospect 整合 + 多个 full-risk 合同 ramp 带来执行风险。

thesis: 受监管水务公司按算法重申 8% EPS 增长指引、加派息 8.2%，Essential Utilities 并购拿到首个州（Kentucky）批准；缺乏慢变量惊喜，这类稳态执行市场会较快定价。
red_flags: 并购仍需 6/7 州审批（含 PA/NJ），预计 2027Q1 才 close；年中约 $1B equity forward 结算；EPS 后半年加权、依赖 PA/NJ 费率案结果；Q&A 直接量化、无明显回避。

thesis: B&G 正重塑为更小、更高毛利、更低杠杆的组合（剥离 Green Giant、收购 broth），base business 企稳且 Q1 开局强（YTD +4%），但 headline 销售因剥离下滑、杠杆仍高达 6.57x——市场需数周穿透 M&A 噪音看清改善中的核心趋势。
red_flags: 杠杆极高（净债/EBITDA 6.57x）；多笔非现金减值（Green Giant $34.8M、Victoria/McCann's $26M、GG Canada $27.8M）；Q4 及 FY2025 净亏损；指引不含 pending 交易（可见度有限）；大量宏观对冲（'unpredictable times'、关税、地区冲突）。

thesis: Broadridge 明确上调 FY2026 经常性收入（>=7%）与 Adjusted EPS（10-12%）指引、Q3 EPS +11%，并押注 tokenization/AI/digitization；但同时下调销售 (bookings) 指引——市场即时为指引上调欢呼，却可能用数周消化 bookings 走弱这个领先指标。
red_flags: closed sales 同比 -16%、销售指引下调至 $240-290M（领先指标转弱，管理层归因于大单成交更慢）；GTO 资本市场 license 收入 headwind；digitization 或使经常性收入减少 'a few %'（称由新服务抵消）；经营利润率 -90bps。
